# blender-stop-condition-decider (reference summary)

## Purpose
Define explicit "done" conditions for a Blender recipe before starting work, so the agent stops at the right point instead of drifting into endless polish.

Pin a single, explicit stop condition for one recipe BEFORE work begins—consisting of one concrete sentence, an explicit out-of-scope list, and a handoff trigger—so the agent stops at the right point instead of drifting into endless polish. Firing the stop condition routes the deliverable to the next skill; it never upgrades any runtime or artifact truth state. Inspired by Anthropic Superpowers `/just-say-when-it's-done` analog.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/blender-stop-condition-decider/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/blender-stop-condition-decider/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `process-discipline` / `done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- BEFORE starting work on any non-trivial single Blender recipe
- after `blender-recipe-decomposer` has isolated a single recipe and `acceptance-criteria-builder` has provided measurable acceptance rows
- when previous attempts drifted into endless polish or unclear completion boundaries

## Trigger cues
- "when are we done"
- "let's set the bar"
- "what does done look like"

## When not to use
- pure exploration or brainstorming → delegate to `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skills/blender-brainstorming.md`; use blender-brainstorming; goal is divergence)
- tiny single-shot requests → delegate to `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)
- splitting a broad multi-recipe request beforehand → delegate to `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skills/blender-recipe-decomposer.md`; use blender-recipe-decomposer first)
- authoring measurable acceptance rows from scratch → delegate to `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skills/acceptance-criteria-builder.md`; use acceptance-criteria-builder first)
- enforcing per-stage checklist gates during execution → delegate to `blender-checklist-driven-workflow` (`references/skills/blender-checklist-driven-workflow.md`; use blender-checklist-driven-workflow)
- after work has already started and scope is drifting mid-flight → delegate to `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skills/blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`; use blender-scope-boundary-enforcer)
- performing the final verification gate before delivery → delegate to `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skills/pre-handoff-verification.md`; use pre-handoff-verification)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Locked 8-slot 3D brief defining deliverable intent
- `acceptance_criteria_rows` (`array`): Measurable Pass/Warn/Fail criteria from acceptance-criteria-builder

### Optional inputs
- `iteration_budget_preference` (`integer`): Maximum refinement passes before halting or escalating

### Primary outputs
- `definition_of_done_checklist`
- `max_iteration_caps_per_stage`
- `halt_and_escalation_triggers`

## Quick-start procedure
1. write one stop condition per recipe (one sentence, concrete)
2. write what is OUT OF SCOPE for "done"
3. write the handoff trigger (which skill receives the deliverable when stop condition fires)
4. enforce: do not polish past the stop condition; do not declare done before it

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Intent brief → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`) — `when.all: [goal.clarity equals "clear"; brief.locked equals false]`
- **[boundary_delegation]** Scope splitting beforehand → `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skills/blender-recipe-decomposer.md`) — `when.all: [fit.multiDeliverableDetected equals true]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Measurable acceptance rows → `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skills/acceptance-criteria-builder.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "acceptance_criteria"]`
- **[progression]** Per-stage workflow gates → `blender-checklist-driven-workflow` (`references/skills/blender-checklist-driven-workflow.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "stage_gates"]`
- **[progression]** Mid-flight scope drift → `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skills/blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`) — `when.all: [scope.driftDetected equals true]`
- **[progression]** Artifact and render evidence → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- **[progression]** Final pre-handoff gate → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skills/pre-handoff-verification.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "final_verification"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Process and discipline skill only—no Python code and no Blender execution. This skill writes the stop condition before work starts and routes handoff when the condition is met; it never executes runtime tasks or upgrades truth states.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Split multi-recipe scope (`blender-recipe-decomposer`).
- Author raw measurable acceptance rows (`acceptance-criteria-builder`).
- Enforce per-stage checklist gates (`blender-checklist-driven-workflow`).
- Police mid-flight scope drift (`blender-scope-boundary-enforcer`).
- Gate the final delivery (`pre-handoff-verification`) or upgrade runtime/artifact truth states.
